bar: Markers are first-person directive phrases attested in the durable record — his characteristic speech acts, not generic praise words. The bar for adding a marker never lowers over time. This file is append-only and versioned: markers are added, never edited or removed; a marker that stops being characteristic is superseded by a new version, not deleted.

markers.note: Ratification speech act. Strongest marker: an explicit authorization.

markers.attested_in: briefing (Lane Claim Arbitration Law: his 'word' ratifies law; 'WORD!' about a process)
AGENTS.md (The Intel Intake Law, 2026-10-11 — his words)

markers.marker: acknowledge it and make it right
markers.note: Corrective directive after a real failure.

purpose: C1 channel (team feeds) authorship attribution for the observed-experience instrument. A feed comment posting under the shared account is attributed to Shawn only if it carries one of these markers (or quotes his words explicitly per the design).
